schema: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY; PRAGMA cache_size=-4096; CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_customers_region ON customers(region); CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_items_customer_qty ON items(customer_id, quantity);

queries.name: select_pk
queries.label: SELECT por ID
queries.sql: SELECT id, quantity, price, label FROM items WHERE id = ?

queries.name: where_indexed
queries.label: WHERE com índice
queries.sql: SELECT id, quantity, price, label FROM items WHERE customer_id = ? AND quantity >= ? ORDER BY id

queries.name: where_scan
queries.label: WHERE com varredura
queries.sql: SELECT id, quantity, price, label FROM items WHERE quantity >= ? AND quantity < ? ORDER BY id

queries.name: join_pk
queries.label: INNER JOIN + WHERE por ID
queries.sql: SELECT i.id, i.quantity, i.price, i.label, c.region FROM items AS i INNER JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.id = ? AND c.active = 1

queries.name: join_indexed
queries.label: INNER JOIN + WHERE com índice
queries.sql: SELECT i.id, i.quantity, i.price, i.label, c.region FROM items AS i INNER JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.customer_id = ? AND c.region = ? AND i.quantity >= ? ORDER BY i.id

queries.name: join_scan
queries.label: INNER JOIN + WHERE com varredura
queries.sql: SELECT i.id, i.quantity, i.price, i.label, c.region FROM items AS i INNER JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE (i.quantity + c.region) % 10 = ? ORDER BY i.id
